title: Profile Isolation
subtitle: Ashfall content stays in Ashfall surfaces
summary: Ashfall-specific strings, route ids, factions, hazards, and chapter hooks belong in the official profile or echoashfallprotocol namespace.
body: Reusable ECHO modules stay standalone. The official Ashfall profile may select shared modules and provide Ashfall-specific starter data, but generic templates must not require echoashfallprotocol or ship Ashfall-only story text.
